blueprint.context: Later the same day, at the Roadwarden licence office. The tile that chapter five turns on is issued here and hung on its thong; the difference between a stamp and a hazard seal is stated by the one person who will have to hold both. Denet Rasca enters the book as an endorsement before he enters as a man, and two questions go unanswered in front of an apprentice who has begun counting them.
objectives: Put the crossing licence tile in Ysoly's hands and establish exactly what it is and how it breaks
Establish Iseul Fane: Third Rank, statute-quoting, stamp-not-seal, 'the Wardenry' not 'the Wardens'
Introduce Denet Rasca as an endorsement on paper, and the fact that he asked for this outfit by name
Contrast the nine-wagon Tamm Line against the thirty-six-wagon joint tile four days behind it
Leave two questions visibly unanswered so Hanei can start noticing which ones are

setting.description: The Roadwarden licence office, two rooms at the head of the seventh quay -- the lowest step cut. Clay dust, hot wax, vinegar for the stamps. A rack of the season's fired tiles cooling on edge, with the unclaimed ones at the far end.

synopsis: Iseul Fane writes the way-bill, names the eleven hands and issues the crossing licence tile. She corrects 'seal' to 'stamp', endorses a passenger Ysoly did not ask for -- a College-sealed Warden-surveyor who requested the Tamm Line by name -- and does not answer why a Warden of the Third Rank is riding out with nine wagons.
title: The Rack of Tiles
